what: Phase 4: fix regressions found while checking the running app

introduction.message:
Phase 4: fix regressions found while checking the running app

- Output slide changes stacked every previous slide on the output. Svelte 5
  revives a {#key} branch when the same key value returns while the old branch
  is still fading out; SlideContent/Overlay toggle {#key show} true -> false ->
  true, so the old SlideItemTransition (with all its accumulated states) came
  back. Key on a counter that changes with every show change instead, which is
  what Svelte 3 did. Compared against a Svelte 3 build: text fades, removal of
  the old slide, rapid presses, clear and image/video backgrounds now match.
- server bundles: Vite 8 no longer polyfills import.meta.url in IIFE output, so
  the dev builds (watchServers / build:servers:dev) of stage and remote threw
  "Invalid URL" for new URL("/import-logos/...", import.meta.url). Define it
  as document.baseURI.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

what: Phase 2: required code changes for Svelte 5 (legacy mode)

introduction.message:
Phase 2: required code changes for Svelte 5 (legacy mode)

- mount(App, { target }) instead of new App({ target }) in the 6 entry points
  (frontend/main.ts and server/{cam,controller,output_stream,remote,stage}/main.ts)
- add |global to every existing transition:/in:/out: directive (42), including
  the custom transition helper, so transitions keep playing when a parent block
  is added/removed as they did in Svelte 3. The one explicit |local
  (remote Slide.svelte) and two commented out directives are untouched.
- Connection.svelte: a {@const connections} shadowed the $connections store,
  which Svelte 5 rejects. Renamed the local to connectionCount.
- Svelte 5 prunes :has()/descendant selectors it cannot match inside the same
  component (matching elements come from slots / other components). Use
  :global() so the rules are kept: FloatingInputs (.overflow,
  .overflow-interact), Popup (.popup-back), Tabs (.tabs :not(:first-child)).
- EditboxCropping: $activeShow! like the other history() callers (type only)
- vite onwarn: also drop Svelte 5's element_invalid_self_closing_tag build log
  noise (165 files); svelte-check still reports it
- server tsconfig: allowJs so the JS-only VirtualList.svelte resolves under
  strict

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

- mount(App, { target }) instead of new App({ target }) in the 6 entry points
  (frontend/main.ts and server/{cam,controller,output_stream,remote,stage}/main.ts)
- add |global to every existing transition:/in:/out: directive (42), including
  the custom transition helper, so transitions keep playing when a parent block
  is added/removed as they did in Svelte 3. The one explicit |local
  (remote Slide.svelte) and two commented out directives are untouched.
- Connection.svelte: a {@const connections} shadowed the $connections store,
  which Svelte 5 rejects. Renamed the local to connectionCount.
- Svelte 5 prunes :has()/descendant selectors it cannot match inside the same
  component (matching elements come from slots / other components). Use
  :global() so the rules are kept: FloatingInputs (.overflow,
  .overflow-interact), Popup (.popup-back), Tabs (.tabs :not(:first-child)).
- EditboxCropping: $activeShow! like the other history() callers (type only)
- vite onwarn: also drop Svelte 5's element_invalid_self_closing_tag build log
  noise (165 files); svelte-check still reports it
- server tsconfig: allowJs so the JS-only VirtualList.svelte resolves under
  strict

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>”

  which Svelte 5 rejects. Renamed the local to connectionCount.
- Svelte 5 prunes :has()/descendant selectors it cannot match inside the same
  component (matching elements come from slots / other components). Use
  :global() so the rules are kept: FloatingInputs (.overflow,
  .overflow-interact), Popup (.popup-back), Tabs (.tabs :not(:first-child)).
- EditboxCropping: $activeShow! like the other history() callers (type only)

Add output-aware backgrounds, show-level outputs and linked slides

- Background inheritance on slide click now only uses slides meant for each output, including output-specific clear-background cues

- Two neighbouring slides can be linked into one card that activates both on click

what: Only remove from the arrangement when deleting a group in the arrangement bar

introduction.message:
Only remove from the arrangement when deleting a group in the arrangement bar

Right clicking a group in the arrangement order had no menu, and Delete
went through the normal slide delete, which removes the slide from the song.
Groups in the arrangement bar now get a "Remove group" menu and Delete only
removes them from the arrangement, the group stays in the show.
